say:4:1710835002:0.text: ... Merlin. That sickening hero act of yours.
say:4:1710835002:0.source_cn: ……梅林。你那令人作呕的英雄做派。
say:4:1710835002:0.male: ... Merlin. That sickening hero act of yours.
say:4:1710835002:0.female: ... Merlin. That sickening hero act of yours.

say:5:1710835003:1.text: How long do you intend to keep standing in my way?
say:5:1710835003:1.source_cn: 你到底还要碍事到什么时候？
say:5:1710835003:1.male: How long do you intend to keep standing in my way?
say:5:1710835003:1.female: How long do you intend to keep standing in my way?

choice_prompt:6:1710835003.text: How long do you intend to keep standing in my way?
choice_prompt:6:1710835003.source_cn: 你到底还要碍事到什么时候？
choice_prompt:6:1710835003.male: How long do you intend to keep standing in my way?
choice_prompt:6:1710835003.female: How long do you intend to keep standing in my way?

say:7:1710835004:1.text: What am I trying to do?
say:7:1710835004:1.male: What am I trying to do?
say:7:1710835004:1.female: What am I trying to do?

say:8:1710835006:1.text: You truly think I did all of this for that pathetic wretch wheezing in bed?
say:8:1710835006:1.source_cn: 你真的以为我所做的一切，只是为了杀掉床上那个苟延残喘的...
say:8:1710835006:1.male: You truly think I did all of this for that pathetic wretch wheezing in bed?
say:8:1710835006:1.female: You truly think I did all of this for that pathetic wretch wheezing in bed?

say:9:1710835007:1.text: Look at him. Weak. Useless. Shackled by outdated notions of legitimacy and hypocritical mercy.
say:9:1710835007:1.source_cn: 看看他。软弱，无能，被陈腐的正统和虚伪的仁慈所束缚。
say:9:1710835007:1.male: Look at him. Weak. Useless. Shackled by outdated notions of legitimacy and hypocritical mercy.
say:9:1710835007:1.female: Look at him. Weak. Useless. Shackled by outdated notions of legitimacy and hypocritical mercy.

say:10:1710835008:1.text: And look at this world, Merlin. This so-called order. These kingdoms. This chapel...
say:10:1710835008:1.source_cn: 你再看看这个世界，梅林。 看看这些所谓的秩序、王国、圣...
say:10:1710835008:1.male: And look at this world, Merlin. This so-called order. These kingdoms. This chapel...
say:10:1710835008:1.female: And look at this world, Merlin. This so-called order. These kingdoms. This chapel...

say:11:1710835009:1.text: They are the true root of this world's decay.
say:11:1710835009:1.source_cn: 他们，才是这个世界腐烂的根源。
say:11:1710835009:1.male: They are the true root of this world's decay.
say:11:1710835009:1.female: They are the true root of this world's decay.

say:12:1710835010:1.text: And I... I am merely cleansing it.
say:12:1710835010:1.source_cn: 而我……只是在进行必要的净化。
say:12:1710835010:1.male: And I... I am merely cleansing it.
say:12:1710835010:1.female: And I... I am merely cleansing it.

choice_prompt:13:1710835010.text: And I... I am merely cleansing it.
choice_prompt:13:1710835010.source_cn: 而我……只是在进行必要的净化。
choice_prompt:13:1710835010.male: And I... I am merely cleansing it.
choice_prompt:13:1710835010.female: And I... I am merely cleansing it.

say:14:1710835011:1.text: Oh, Merlin... you truly still don't understand. To those with real strength, chaos is hardly a calamity. It's selection.
say:14:1710835011:1.source_cn: 呵，你还是不懂。对于真正的强者而言，混乱并非灾难，而是...
say:14:1710835011:1.male: Oh, Merlin... you truly still don't understand. To those with real strength, chaos is hardly a calamity. It's selection.
say:14:1710835011:1.female: Oh, Merlin... you truly still don't understand. To those with real strength, chaos is hardly a calamity. It's selection.

say:15:1710835012:1.text: If you want to cut away rotting flesh, there will be blood. Shatter this wretched, mediocre order. That's how a new world is born.
say:15:1710835012:1.source_cn: 要想切除腐肉，必然伴随着鲜血。打破该死的、平庸的秩序—...
say:15:1710835012:1.male: If you want to cut away rotting flesh, there will be blood. Shatter this wretched, mediocre order. That's how a new world is born.
say:15:1710835012:1.female: If you want to cut away rotting flesh, there will be blood. Shatter this wretched, mediocre order. That's how a new world is born.

choice_prompt:16:1710835012.text: If you want to cut away rotting flesh, there will be blood. Shatter this wretched, mediocre order. That's how a new world is born.
choice_prompt:16:1710835012.source_cn: 要想切除腐肉，必然伴随着鲜血。打破该死的、平庸的秩序——才是通往新世界的净化之路。
choice_prompt:16:1710835012.male: If you want to cut away rotting flesh, there will be blood. Shatter this wretched, mediocre order. That's how a new world is born.
choice_prompt:16:1710835012.female: If you want to cut away rotting flesh, there will be blood. Shatter this wretched, mediocre order. That's how a new world is born.

say:17:1710835013:1.text: "Betrayal"? "Murder"? My, how severe you sound. Your vision is as narrow as it was at the academy. You insisted on seeing everything in such earnest shades of right and wrong.
say:17:1710835013:1.source_cn: “背叛”？“谋杀”？梅林，你的眼界，就和在学院时一样，...
say:17:1710835013:1.male: "Betrayal"? "Murder"? My, how severe you sound. Your vision is as narrow as it was at the academy. You insisted on seeing everything in such earnest shades of right and wrong.
say:17:1710835013:1.female: "Betrayal"? "Murder"? My, how severe you sound. Your vision is as narrow as it was at the academy. You insisted on seeing everything in such earnest shades of right and wrong.

say:18:1710835015:1.text: And that is the one thing I never understood about you.
say:18:1710835015:1.source_cn: 而这，正是我最无法理解你的一点。
say:18:1710835015:1.male: And that is the one thing I never understood about you.
say:18:1710835015:1.female: And that is the one thing I never understood about you.

say:19:1710835016:1.text: You possessed the brilliance all of us—yes, myself included—could only admire from a distance. And yet... what did you do with it?
say:19:1710835016:1.source_cn: 你明明拥有我们所有人……包括我……都梦寐以求的才能，你...
say:19:1710835016:1.male: You possessed the brilliance all of us—yes, myself included—could only admire from a distance. And yet... what did you do with it?
say:19:1710835016:1.female: You possessed the brilliance all of us—yes, myself included—could only admire from a distance. And yet... what did you do with it?

say:20:1710835017:1.text: You chose to sacrifice yourself for this pathetic world. To fall into slumber, to lose your memory and become... this?
say:20:1710835017:1.source_cn: 为了这个可悲的世界去牺牲？去沉睡？甚至不惜失去记忆，变...
say:20:1710835017:1.male: You chose to sacrifice yourself for this pathetic world. To fall into slumber, to lose your memory and become... this?
say:20:1710835017:1.female: You chose to sacrifice yourself for this pathetic world. To fall into slumber, to lose your memory and become... this?

say:21:1710835018:1.text: Power enough to steer the world, and you treated it like something inconvenient.
say:21:1710835018:1.source_cn: 你把足以掌控世界的力量，当成了垃圾一样丢在了一边！
say:21:1710835018:1.male: Power enough to steer the world, and you treated it like something inconvenient.
say:21:1710835018:1.female: Power enough to steer the world, and you treated it like something inconvenient.

say:22:1710835019:1.text: You abandoned power. I, on the other hand... embraced it.
say:22:1710835019:1.source_cn: 梅林，你抛弃了力量。而我……我选择了它。
say:22:1710835019:1.male: You abandoned power. I, on the other hand... embraced it.
say:22:1710835019:1.female: You abandoned power. I, on the other hand... embraced it.

choice_prompt:23:1710835019.text: You abandoned power. I, on the other hand... embraced it.
choice_prompt:23:1710835019.source_cn: 梅林，你抛弃了力量。而我……我选择了它。
choice_prompt:23:1710835019.male: You abandoned power. I, on the other hand... embraced it.
choice_prompt:23:1710835019.female: You abandoned power. I, on the other hand... embraced it.

say:25:1710835021:1.text: Very well. I had intended to address the Empire's so-called king first. But I've changed my mind.
say:25:1710835021:1.source_cn: 也好， 我本想先处理掉耀光这个所谓的国王，但现在我改主意了。
say:25:1710835021:1.male: Very well. I had intended to address the Empire's so-called king first. But I've changed my mind.
say:25:1710835021:1.female: Very well. I had intended to address the Empire's so-called king first. But I've changed my mind.

say:26:1710835022:1.text: Since your awakening, we've never had the courtesy of a proper duel.
say:26:1710835022:1.source_cn: 从你苏醒之后，我们从未正式交过手。
say:26:1710835022:1.male: Since your awakening, we've never had the courtesy of a proper duel.
say:26:1710835022:1.female: Since your awakening, we've never had the courtesy of a proper duel.

say:27:1710835023:1.text: So today, let me see how much of that genius remains after twenty years of sleep and amnesia!
say:27:1710835023:1.source_cn: 今天就让我看看！沉睡了二十年、又失去了记忆的你，还剩下...
say:27:1710835023:1.male: So today, let me see how much of that genius remains after twenty years of sleep and amnesia!
say:27:1710835023:1.female: So today, let me see how much of that genius remains after twenty years of sleep and amnesia!

say:29:1710835014:1.text: I'm simply doing what others lack the courage to do.
say:29:1710835014:1.source_cn: 我只是在做很多人不敢做的事情。
say:29:1710835014:1.male: I'm simply doing what others lack the courage to do.
say:29:1710835014:1.female: I'm simply doing what others lack the courage to do.

choice:16:1:2.text: Is this what the Syndicate taught you?
choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 这就是你从黑金商会学到的东西吗？
choice:16:1:2.male: Is this what the Syndicate taught you?
choice:16:1:2.female: Is this what the Syndicate taught you?

choice:13:0:1.text: So this is why you joined the Syndicate?
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 这就是你投靠黑金商会的理由？
choice:13:0:1.male: So this is why you joined the Syndicate?
choice:13:0:1.female: So this is why you joined the Syndicate?

choice:13:1:2.text: You'd plunge the world into chaos for "purification"?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 为了所谓的“净化”，不惜让世界陷入混乱？
choice:13:1:2.male: You'd plunge the world into chaos for "purification"?
choice:13:1:2.female: You'd plunge the world into chaos for "purification"?

choice:6:0:1.text: What exactly are you trying to do?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷，你到底想干什么？
choice:6:0:1.male: What exactly are you trying to do?
choice:6:0:1.female: What exactly are you trying to do?

say:30:1710835005:1.text: Hah. Merlin, you're still just as naive as ever.
say:30:1710835005:1.source_cn: 呵，梅林，你还是……一如既往的天真。
say:30:1710835005:1.male: Hah. Merlin, you're still just as naive as ever.
say:30:1710835005:1.female: Hah. Merlin, you're still just as naive as ever.

choice:6:1:2.text: Are you planning to harm the King?
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你想对国王和王后下手吗？
choice:6:1:2.male: Are you planning to harm the King?
choice:6:1:2.female: Are you planning to harm the King?
